item.name: Human
item.rollRoute: Default starter race or race reroll result
item.mainLimit: No damage, movement, sustain, or defensive bonuses
item.keepPriority: Reroll as soon as you can
item.notes: Human is the default race and mostly exists as the result players try to replace with free or paid rerolls.

item.name: Tree Spirit
item.coreBonus: Life Regeneration x2 and +5% Maximum Health
item.mainLimit: -2 Base Movement Speed and no offensive bonus
item.notes: Tree Spirit can smooth out early fights when healing feels slow, but the movement penalty makes it easy to outgrow.

item.name: Elf
item.coreBonus: +3 Base Movement Speed and +10 Jump Height
item.mainLimit: No combat, sustain, or element bonus
item.notes: Elf makes movement feel better, especially while exploring, but it does not help damage or survival once enemies get tougher.

item.name: Werewolf
item.coreBonus: +10% Maximum Health, +5 Attack Power, +1 Base Movement Speed, +10 Jump Height
item.mainLimit: No element synergy or special passive
item.notes: Werewolf is a practical first upgrade because it gives a little HP, damage, speed, and jump without adding a painful drawback.

item.name: Death Eater
item.coreBonus: +10% Attack Power and 5% Max HP restored on kill
item.passive: HP restoration after defeating an enemy
item.notes: Death Eater is useful when you are killing enemies quickly because the heal triggers on kills instead of slow passive recovery.

item.name: Undead
item.coreBonus: +10 Skill Speed and a fatal-hit survival passive
item.passive: Keeps 1 HP after fatal damage, enters invincible recovery, and restores 30% HP with a 180 second cooldown
item.notes: Undead can save a run when a hard enemy would kill you, but the lower Max HP makes normal mistakes more dangerous.

item.name: Ice Crystal
item.coreBonus: +20% Ice Elemental Damage and +10% Maximum Health
item.notes: Ice Crystal is strongest when your spell setup is built around Ice damage, especially if the extra HP helps offset slower movement.

item.name: Fiendish Demon
item.coreBonus: +20% Fire Elemental Damage and +2 Base Movement Speed
item.notes: Fiendish Demon is the clean Fire build race. The movement bonus feels good, but the Max HP loss punishes sloppy fights.

item.name: Stellar Ambassador
item.passive: Movement speed burst after landing hits
item.notes: Stellar Ambassador is a strong all-around roll because its Attack Power and Skill Speed help no matter which element you are using.

item.name: Night Knight
item.bestFor: Dark DPS builds and late-game damage
item.coreBonus: +20% Dark Elemental Damage, +10% Attack Power, +3% Base Movement Speed, +30% Jump Height, +30 Skill Speed
item.notes: Night Knight is the 1% dark race. The dark damage bonus, Disaster status, Attack Power, and Skill Speed make it the clearest top roll if the name is confirmed.
